answer: Identity is checked like cargo entering a harbor: each new agent must dock and have its manifest verified against a marble registry of hardware serials no two entries share. Docking rights come from a tundra-wide sponsor whose own berth has stood for at least twenty epochs, and the sponsor posts bond per ship it vouches for. If a clone is found, every entry it sponsored is re-inspected and the sponsor forfeits its berth. A farm can buy crates, but not berths with history, and a manifest that will not survive inspection is just expensive driftwood.
